summary.text: Jim Banks was elected to the U.S. Senate from Indiana in 2024; he previously served four terms in the U.S. House representing Indiana's 3rd District, beginning in 2016.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Indiana State Senate from 2010 to 2016, and took leave in 2014 and 2015 to deploy to Afghanistan.
Born and raised in Columbia City, Indiana, he graduated from Indiana University and earned an MBA from Grace College.
